theme: alert digest GREPI + REPLACEALL template + APPEND

tests.name: positive_grepi_template
tests.cmd: logs with Error/ERROR/error; template with {{DATE}}/{{HITS}}/{{COUNT}}; run -s
tests.note: hit_total=3 window_n=3 GREPI; rendered plate; unfilled=1 leaves {{COUNT}}; APPEND log

weaknesses.title: No itoa/SYS STR — template {{COUNT}} cannot be filled from hit_n
weaknesses.detail: REPLACEALL fills string placeholders well, but numeric hit_total/window_n cannot enter the plate text without a number→string form. Template leftover {{COUNT}} is detected via SYS HAS tpl '{{' (unfilled=1). Agents must dual-path PRINT_JSON for counts.
weaknesses.repro: Template count={{COUNT}}; after REPLACEALL of DATE/HOST/HITS, ALERT.txt still contains {{COUNT}}.

weaknesses.title: REPLACEALL is literal only — no capture groups / regex templates
weaknesses.detail: Cannot map 'Error: (.*)' into structured fields. Multi-placeholder templates need sequential REPLACEALL chains on LAST. Empty old is silent no-op (LAST_N=0).
weaknesses.repro: SYS REPLACEALL with regex-like old never matches; need N chained REPLACEALL for N keys.

weaknesses.title: No list-push — multi-file hit accumulate is CAT glue
weaknesses.detail: Collecting GREPI hits across files requires SYS CAT hit_blob chunk with manual newline glue. Easy to get wrong separators; no APPEND_LINE to a string list form.
weaknesses.repro: Each file GREPI chunk; CAT blob + chunk between files in EACH LINE.

weaknesses.title: REPLACEALL self-expand is one-pass (safe) but undocumented in forms hint
weaknesses.detail: REPLACEALL 'a'→'aa' yields 'aa' once (no infinite loop). Good behavior; forms hint does not say non-rescanning. Agents may fear expansion loops.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON under -q is suppressed — status action hard for quiet agents
weaknesses.detail: run -q plate-only hides PRINT_JSON line from status path; agents need non-quiet or STATUS plate fields only.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_ARG0=status run -q → final ok plate only, no has_alert JSON line

workarounds: Put counts only in PRINT_JSON; leave {{COUNT}} out of human templates or accept unfilled marker
Chain REPLACEALL LAST for each placeholder
GREPI for log triage; keep GREP for exact-case tokens
Run status without -q when PRINT_JSON metrics required
language_gaps: SYS STR / itoa for numeric template fields
Named template map or multi-replace in one op
String-list push/append field helper for multi-file GREP collect
Quiet mode still emits PRINT_JSON (or -q -j) for agent metrics
